title: Glass Controls (appearance.glassControls, off by default): Settings switch and slider knobs drawn as glass

steps.title: Settings > Experimental > Labs: the Glass Controls row, today's switches (Glass Controls off)
Glass Controls on: the switch knobs turn to glass
A switch flipped while Glass Controls is on: the glass knob slides over the accent track
Settings > Appearance: the slider knobs are glass too
steps.optional: Settings may open on another section

steps.title: Back to Settings > Experimental > Labs: the glass knobs on the Glass Controls and Experimental Appearance Controls switches
Glass Controls off again: today's controls exactly
